title: Yutani configuration
description: Schema for Yutani's TOML config file (~/.config/yutani/config.toml on Linux, ~/Library/Application Support/yutani/config.toml on macOS). Unknown keys are ignored by the app; this schema flags them as typos. Generated from src/config.rs (Config::apply / Config::defaults).

font_size.description: Font point size. Clamped to [6, 96] at load.

font_family.description: Preferred font family (matched by Core Text on macOS / fontconfig on Linux). Empty string uses the built-in default.

text_gamma.description: Gamma curve applied to glyph coverage in the shader: alpha' = pow(coverage, 1.0 / text_gamma). 1.0 is identity (unchanged); >1 thickens/softens anti-aliased edges, <1 thins them. Clamped to [0.25, 4.0].

font_hinting.description: FreeType hinting target used when rasterizing glyphs. 'normal' reproduces the historical output. 'light' keeps stems closer to their anti-aliased shape (often smoother at small sizes); 'none' disables hinting; 'full' maps to the same target as 'normal' (FreeType has no separate full target).

color_scheme.description: Name of the color scheme to load (a file under the schemes/ directory, without .toml). Empty string uses the built-in defaults.

auto_theme.description: When true, pick light_scheme/dark_scheme based on the system appearance instead of always using color_scheme.

light_scheme.description: Scheme name used for the light system appearance when auto_theme is on. Falls back to color_scheme if unset.

dark_scheme.description: Scheme name used for the dark system appearance when auto_theme is on. Falls back to color_scheme if unset.

cursor_anim_secs.description: Ease-in-out duration (seconds) for cursor position changes. 0 snaps instantly.

scroll_on_output_secs.description: Ease-out duration (seconds) for the smooth scroll-on-output slide. 0 disables the animation.

scroll_edge_style.description: Style of the top scroll-edge effect where scrollback meets the title-bar chrome. 'soft' is a gradient blur fade; 'hard' is an opaque backing with a crisp edge.

top_fade_height.description: Height (px) of the top scroll-edge fade band.

top_fade_anim_secs.description: Animation duration (seconds) for the top fade band.

bottom_fade_height.description: Height (px) of the bottom scroll-edge fade band.

bottom_fade_anim_secs.description: Animation duration (seconds) for the bottom fade band.

glow_match_brightness.description: Apply the glow/bloom effect to cells brighter than glow_threshold.

glow_match_bright_ansi.description: Treat the bright (8-15) ANSI palette colors as glow sources.

glow_match_foreground.description: Treat the default foreground color as a glow source (catches achromatic default text).

glow_fg_tolerance.description: Color distance tolerance for matching the foreground color as a glow source (0 = exact). Max is sqrt(3).

glow_threshold.description: Luminance above which a cell contributes to the glow when glow_match_brightness is on.

glow_hue_tolerance_deg.description: Hue tolerance (degrees) when matching glow source colors.

glow_iterations.description: Number of dual-Kawase blur iterations for the glow. More iterations = wider, softer bloom.

glow_scanlines.description: Draw CRT-style scanlines over glowing content.

glow_scanlines_content.description: Also draw scanlines over non-glowing terminal content.

glow_scanlines_content_strength.description: Scanline strength for ordinary content when glow_scanlines_content is on.

glow_scanlines_content_attenuation.description: How much the content scanlines are attenuated relative to glow scanlines.

glow_scanlines_skip_primary_bg.description: Skip scanlines over cells using the primary background color.

glow_scanline_color_bright.description: Bright scanline color as a hex RGB integer, e.g. 0xffffff.

glow_scanline_color_dark.description: Dark scanline color as a hex RGB integer, e.g. 0x000000.

theme_overrides_glow.description: When true, a color scheme's own glow settings win over the values in this file.

images_enabled.description: Enable inline image support (GPU image draw + protocol parsing).

images_memory_cap_mb.description: Upper bound (MB) on total bytes the image store holds. 0 effectively disables image residency.

images_max_pixels.description: Per-decode pixel-count rejection threshold (e.g. 16777216 = 4096x4096). Decodes larger than this are refused before allocation.

images_decode_timeout_ms.description: Per-decode deadline (ms). A pending request older than this is dropped. Floored at 50ms.

images_in_scrollback.description: Keep image placements that scroll off the top of the grid in scrollback instead of dropping them.

images_filter.description: Sampler for new image uploads. 'linear' smooths under scaling; 'nearest' keeps pixels crisp.

images_halfblock_for_missing.description: Render placements as Unicode half-block (▀) glyphs when the GPU image draw is unavailable (disabled or decode failed).

shell_exit_mode.description: What the window does when the child shell exits. 'always' closes regardless; 'never' keeps it open with a status line; 'on_success' closes on a clean (0) exit and keeps it open otherwise.

prompt_gutter.description: OSC 133 prompt-status indicator in the left margin. 'none' is off; 'bar' draws a per-prompt vertical bar (green/red/dim).

autocomplete.description: Show the filesystem/history autocomplete popup as you type.
